text_block_list.text:
Right before the Oka Sho, the first leg of the
Triple Tiara, Yukino Bijin was giving interviews
to the media.
It's common for a spotlight Umamusume to hold a press conference. However...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Yukino-chan,
what did you eat last night?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's katsudon, y'all!
I cooked it up for good luck!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Nice! By the way...
Yukino-chan, you're a student right now, right?
Who do you want watching your race the most?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't choose just one!
There's Mom, Dad, my little sister, my friends—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful! Is there anything else, though...?
Like, someone you have a crush on?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Someone I like...?
...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah?! N-N-N-No, there isn't anyone here!!

Most of the questions directed at Yukino Bijin pried into her private life.
The atmosphere was completely different from regular interviews.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could you say a few words to the fans watching on TV, then?
Oh, in your dialect, please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run my heart out!
Please cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that just a dialect?
I don't understand it at all...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! 
My accent was completely out on display!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aya!?
(Hahahaha...!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. The TV stations around here
don't usually cover races, do they?

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's huge in the news right now.
Even our director gave orders to make sure we snap plenty of good photos of her.

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
She's like a celebrity.
This popularity is reaching a fever pitch...

Many Umamusume have been featured in the media
and gained popularity before, but...
the way she was received was a bit different.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Time's up!
That concludes Yukino Bijin's interview!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew~...
That was so thrilling and minty-fresh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Did I do it right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's mighty fine to hear!
Well then, I'll just—

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: And now, we will begin the Q&A session for the next Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, is it next...!
Time for the star of the show to take the stage!

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna be the first one
to publish an article about her!"

Suddenly, the atmosphere in the room shifted.
The reporters who entered in place of the TV crew
had a tense air about them.
choice_data_list: (The next Uma Musume is, let's see...)

text_block_list.text: (*Sparkle*...)

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha"-san,
looking forward to working with you today.

"Harp Alpha"—she's
one of the highly anticipated Umamusume
on the Triple Tiara route.
She's very likely to be Yukino Bijin's biggest rival at the Oka Sho as well. I've been keeping an eye on her, but...
choice_data_list: (I didn't realize I was getting this much attention.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
May I stay and watch her press conference?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My heart feels kind of restless...
I feel like I really need to hear this out properly.

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha-san.
Heading into the Oka Sho with such high expectations, how are you feeling?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
After your first victory, it seemed like you felt some discomfort in your leg, correct?
Is everything fine now?

text_block_list.name: Racing Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
She ran a grueling race last time.
Could she still have fatigue lingering?
Sharp questions flew one after another in rapid succession. The atmosphere was completely different from the earlier press conference with Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: "...I will run my own race. That is all I can say."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's amazin'...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—She was
so cool, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Unflinching in the face of any question, dignified and confident."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nope!
It's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the Triple Tiara,
there sure are a lot of tough-looking girls after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gotta psych myself up and give it my all!
—I'm off!
